title: Continual coordinate-first skill acquisition
hypothesis: For an ordered stream of 12 linear skills, first fitting each new skill with an existing shared Mirror coordinate and only adding a physical basis direction when validation nMSE exceeds 1e-4 will preserve every prior task, use fewer serialized bytes than task-local vectors, and add basis directions only for a new subspace family or unrelated skills. Direct coefficient coding on the same evolving basis is the mandatory nearest control.
physical_object: shared FP16 basis of task weight vectors in a 64-dimensional linear map
mirror_coordinate: one phase and fixed radius over the initial aligned two-vector subspace; direct coefficients on any subsequently added basis directions
logical_multiplicity: 12 sequential functions, including one new two-dimensional subspace family and four unrelated functions
controls: hard-tied initial basis with no task coordinates
ordinary evolving shared basis with free least-squares coefficients and validation-triggered rank-one growth
coordinate-first Mirror phase on initial orbit plus direct coordinates after basis growth; same private/growth rule
task-local independent FP16 vectors upper control

storage.authority: actual deterministic serialized inference payload bytes after reload at every stream step
storage.growth_rule: when validation nMSE exceeds 1e-4, append the normalized support residual as one shared basis direction, refit the task coordinate, and retain the event if validation still fails

gates.promising: All 3 fresh streams retain every previous skill at test nMSE<=1e-4; Mirror final payload <=0.90x evolving direct-basis control and <=0.20x independent vectors; growth occurs only after validation failure and no Mirror-specific extra private tasks are needed.
gates.fail: Any prior-task test nMSE exceeds 1e-4 in >=2 fresh streams, or Mirror payload >= direct control in >=2 streams, or basis growth occurs before validation failure.
gates.not_established: serialized replay mismatch, task-order leakage, or fresh settings changed after access

boundaries: synthetic post-fit linear skill stream, no optimizer updates
basis coordinates are oracle/projection-fit representations, not learned online skills
12 functions do not represent independent capacity
no natural continual-learning benchmark or GPU claim
